title: Grateful Dead Live at Parc des Expositions on 1974-09-18
lineage: SBD> MR> DAT> SS> CDA> EAC> SHN> DAW (Bertha)> CDA/SHN

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear soundboard capture of a late‑1974 European classic with a smoking Uncle John’s Band opener and standout Eyes→China Doll→Ship of Fools run.
ai_review.review: The recording is a solid, mostly pristine soundboard mix—crisp and well‑balanced though a touch thin in the midrange and with occasional dropouts. Musically the show shines: tight band chemistry, a killer UJB opener, superb Eyes solo, and an almost flawless second‑set flow through Eyes, China Doll, He's Gone, Truckin', drums, Caution Jam and Ship of Fools.

ai_rating.rationale: Overwhelmingly positive reviews praise both performance and audio quality; minor mid‑range loss and vocal level issues keep the rating just shy of perfect.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crystal‑clear mix with superb balance, but a slight dip in mids and occasional dropouts; second‑set vocals are low, making it feel more instrumental.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set flows beautifully, highlighted by a powerful UJB opener and an almost perfect Eyes→China Doll→He's Gone→Truckin'→Drums→Caution Jam→Ship of Fools sequence; transitions are tight despite one reviewer noting missing “Milkin’ the Turkey/Stronger Than Dirt” listing.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His segment is described as a life‑changing, edge‑you‑experience moment.
band_member_comments.Phil: His solo on Eyes receives special praise; overall chemistry noted as tight.
band_member_comments.Drums: The drum solo and Caution Jam are highlighted as strong, contributing to the show’s tight feel.
